headline: BI Warning! Food Inflation Still High, Reaching 5.81%
summary: Bank Indonesia warned that food inflation remained high at 5.81%, even as overall inflation was contained at 3.23%, and said it is focused on economic stability and the rupiah.
why: Food inflation drives household costs and shapes Bank Indonesia's interest rate decisions, which affect the rupiah and bond yields.
original_headline: BI Warning! Inflasi Pangan Masih Tinggi, Capai 5,81%
